node.origin: SHA-256 from the release's own SHASUMS256.txt. The same version CI runs on.

electron.origin: SHA-256 from the release's own SHASUMS256.txt, equal to checksums.json of the electron npm package. Keep the version equal to packaging/desktop/package.json.

appimage-runtime.origin: SHA-256 of the release asset as published by GitHub.

appimage-tools.origin: electron-builder's own AppImage toolset (the checksum app-builder-lib 26.15.3 checks): mksquashfs for macOS and Linux, the type 2 runtime (the same file as appimage-runtime) and the libraries every Electron AppImage carries.

cloudflared.origin: Not pinned here: the application fetches cloudflared itself after an npm install, so its pins ship with it. A build reads that same file from the application it stages (lib/stage.mjs provisionCloudflared) and its audit checks the bundle against it.

gitBash.origin: Not pinned here: an npm install on Windows fetches Git for Windows itself, so its pins ship with the application. A Windows build reads that same file from the application it stages (lib/git-bash.mjs provisionGitBash) and its audit checks the bundle against it; no other target carries it.

embeddingModel.origin: SHA-256 of the files the application's own installer (mcp-server setup:embeddings) downloads.
